description: This file is a shell script that defines a set of tests for verifying directory traversal and behavior of git worktree/configurations. It sets up testing repositories, performs git commands, and checks expected file states against actual states, focusing on repository configurations and traversal outside the repository root.

methods.name: test_create_repo
methods.description: Creates a new git repository at the specified path.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting successful execution of the commands inside its block.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares two files or outputs for equality.
